name: crud-workspace
description: Workspace for @nestm/crud and its persistence adapters.
author: nestm

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm run test:postgres:generate && tsc -p tests/postgres/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts
scripts.verify:attw: pnpm exec attw --pack packages/crud --profile esm-only && pnpm exec attw --pack packages/crud-memory --profile esm-only && pnpm exec attw --pack packages/crud-typeorm --profile esm-only && pnpm exec attw --pack packages/crud-drizzle --profile esm-only && pnpm exec attw --pack packages/crud-prisma --profile esm-only
scripts.verify:pack: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter "./packages/*" exec publint --strict && pnpm run verify:attw
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:postgres && pnpm run verify:pack && pnpm run verify:consumer
